description: This file contains the implementation of the Reward API controller for sale-related reward points in the OpenCart system. It defines a class that handles API requests for getting and setting reward points.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class for managing reward points via API endpoints, including methods for retrieving current reward points, maximums, and available rewards.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the main API request to set reward points, validating the requested reward amount against available points and maximums, then setting session data accordingly.

methods.name: maximum
methods.description: Returns the maximum reward points available, calculated from cart contents.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Returns the current reward points available to the customer.
